name: American Electric Company, LLC
old_description: With over seven decades of unparalleled experience, American Electric stands as Hawaii's gold standard in electrical services. Our reputation, built on trust and excellence since 1946, illuminates our commitment to powering the Aloha spirit.
about:
Founded in 1946 and headquartered in Mililani, Hawaii, American Electric Company, LLC has spent more than seven decades as a licensed electrical contractor serving the islands. The company began as a local electrical service provider and has grown into a full-service firm handling industrial, commercial, and residential projects across the state.

The firm delivers a broad range of electrical construction and maintenance services, including design-build projects that use BIM modeling, TotalStation layout, Revit coordination, and prefabrication. It also provides high-voltage system design, installation, testing, and commissioning for power plants, manufacturing facilities, and data centers. Additional capabilities cover ultrasonic testing, de-energized maintenance, guaranteed service programs through its TEGG® contractor affiliation, emergency repairs, installations, modifications, and power-quality diagnostics. The company also installs lighting, circuit panels, generators, EV chargers, and offers controls, telecom, and alternative-energy solutions.

Customers span homeowners, business owners, property managers, and general contractors in sectors such as alternative energy, industrial manufacturing, power generation, data centers, and commercial real estate. The company cites work on iconic landmarks as well as residential homes, and emphasizes coordination with other trades to keep projects on budget and on schedule.

American Electric differentiates itself through a customer-first approach that stresses transparent pricing, timely completion, and safety education.

about:
American Mobility Products, Inc., operating as AMP Kentucky, is headquartered in Campbellsville, Kentucky, with additional locations in Lexington and Louisville. The company provides medical equipment solutions across the Commonwealth.

AMP Kentucky supplies augmentative and alternative communication (AAC) speech-generating devices, sleep apnea and respiratory therapy equipment, and power mobility chairs. The company operates dedicated Sleep, Speech, and Respiratory teams, including licensed respiratory therapists, to support equipment selection, fitting, and ongoing compliance monitoring.

The company serves individuals with speech, sleep, respiratory, and mobility impairments, as well as healthcare providers and caregivers seeking durable medical equipment. Its customer base includes patients requiring AAC devices for communication, CPAP and BiPAP therapy for sleep apnea, and power wheelchairs or scooters for mobility independence.

AMP Kentucky states its goal is to offer high-quality, cost-effective medical equipment solutions that enable customers to achieve the highest possible quality of life, summarized by the tagline "Transforming Care. Elevating Lives."

name: American Steel Fabrication
old_description: Locally owned and operated, American Steel Fabrication is a hands-on subcontractor big enough to handle large projects across the Midwest and small enough to take care of each customer and the inevitable details that follow every project. Having been in business for over 27 years, The ASFI Community is stronger than ever. We pride ourselves on having the best clients in the business, providing a quality product at competitive prices in a fast, friendly and flexible way. President Tim Thomas understands the needs of both clients and contractors and delivers quality workmanship every time. A premier member of the American Subcontractors Association, Midwest Council, American Steel Fabrication has a stellar reputation for unmatched experience and performance.
about:
American Steel Fabrication was founded in 1994 by Tim Thomas and a group of his customers in Pevely, Missouri, a suburb of St. Louis. The company remains locally owned and operated, with Thomas serving as president and drawing on experience that began in the steel construction industry at age 15.

The firm runs a complete fabrication facility supplying both structural and reinforcing steel. It stocks carbon, stainless, and aluminum products in forms including beams, angles, channels, pipe, tube, plate, bar, and sheet, while also fabricating embeds, pipe bollards, adjustable columns, H-pile, joist and deck, and epoxy-coated rebar. Services extend to same-day pickup, next-day delivery, and on-site ironworker erection and installation.

Customers span commercial, industrial, and infrastructure construction across the Midwest. A notable project includes the Ameren Bagnell Dam stabilization, where the company contributed to a 2,453-foot gravity dam requiring 67 post-tension anchors and 17,000 cubic yards of concrete. The client base includes general contractors, subcontractors, and owners such as utility provider Ameren.

Thomas’s background in estimating, accounting, and field operations shapes a culture described as fast, flexible, and friendly. Membership in the American Subcontractors Association Midwest Council and leadership roles in the Steel Institute and Concrete Council reflect a commitment to industry standards and relationships.

Amerifab serves customers in architectural, industrial, pharmaceutical, machinery builder, and food industries. Its client base includes firms requiring custom metal fabrications for equipment, sanitary systems, and architectural elements.

The company emphasizes quality and service with quick turnarounds as its defining differentiators, positioning itself as a responsive job shop for diverse metal fabrication needs.

name: Amtech Systems, Llc
old_description: Founded in 1998, Entrepix, Inc. has become the most recognized independent provider of chemical mechanical polishing (CMP)technology. An early pioneer of the refurbished equipment market, Entrepix subsequently launched the first CMP outsourcing service, through which it developed and now operates the world’s largest CMP technology portfolio. Today Entrepix is the OEM for new OnTrak cleaners and has heavily invested in engineering and fabrication resources to design, develop, and manufacture upgrades, obsolescence solutions, sub-assemblies, and complete electro-mechanical systems for CMP-style polishing and cleaning as well as aerospace defense contracting. Entrepix proudly serves a long and growing lis tof customers that includes many of the world’s most prominent IC fabricators,OEMs, materials suppliers, and defense contractors.
about:
Amtech Systems, Inc. (ASYS) is headquartered in Albuquerque, New Mexico. Founded in 1981, the company operates as a global supplier of semiconductor equipment and materials through four wholly-owned subsidiaries: BTU International, Entrepix Inc., PR Hoffman™, and Intersurface Dynamics.

The company designs, manufactures, and sells capital equipment and consumables for semiconductor fabrication, advanced packaging, and electronics assembly. Its portfolio spans substrate processing — including lapping, polishing, cleaning, etching, and chemical mechanical planarization (CMP) — as well as thermal processing with belt furnaces, diffusion furnaces, and reflow ovens. Entrepix provides CMP outsourcing services, refurbished equipment, and OEM OnTrak cleaners, while BTU International supplies high-volume solder reflow systems for AI semiconductor packaging. Operations span eight locations in five countries.

Amtech serves the power semiconductor market across mobile, computing, industrial, automotive, telecom, and medical sectors. Its customers include integrated circuit fabricators, original equipment manufacturers, materials suppliers, defense contractors, and outsourced semiconductor assembly and test (OSAT) providers. The company's high-volume reflow ovens are used by OSATs and OEMs for advanced packaging of AI semiconductor devices, while its CMP services support major IC fabricators and materials suppliers.

The company cites product quality and customer service as its primary differentiators, positioning itself as a supplier of high-quality solutions. Its growth strategy centers on the silicon carbide and power semiconductor sectors, aiming to maximize revenue through optimization of existing businesses, rationalization of product lines, leveraging corporate capabilities, and strategic acquisitions.
